character: 이전 배경 테스트 범위를 이어 캐릭터 없이 중앙 배치 지점 확보
composition: 뾰족한 폭풍 구름 실루엣 안의 후경과 수직 천광. 중앙 발밑 지점에서 지면을 따라 좌우·후방·전경으로 퍼지는 방사형 전격.
prompt:
TEST 4 — DIVINE PUNISHMENT / LIGHTNING SPREADING OUTWARD FROM A CHARACTER'S FEET. Create a NEW background-and-effects-only fantasy game splash illustration. No character is drawn, but plan a clear standing position in the center. The attached references are ONLY for polished 2D anime rendering, SHAPED scenic backdrop, internal spatial depth and effects crossing that backdrop's boundary. Do not copy any character or scene. This must be a fresh composition, not a revision of an oblique diagonal lightning wedge.

ESSENTIAL ACTION — ELECTRICITY STARTS AT THE FEET:
An empty, small character standing area lies at center-lower frame on a clearly foreshortened stone ground, around 65–70 percent down the canvas. From a compact white-gold electrical origin immediately UNDER this standing area, branching lightning explodes RADIALLY OUTWARD across the floor in all directions. The motion is CENTER → PERIPHERY: toward the foreground viewer, to the left and right, and toward the rear.
Show five or six unequal jagged principal branches with numerous progressively thinner forks. They follow the ground perspective, crawl across stone, skip over gaps, and occasionally rise in short crackling arcs above the surface. Nearer branches become larger and sharply foreshortened, distant branches finer and shorter. Bright white cores, energetic pale-gold edges, a little cool violet corona. There are bright electrical contact points where bolts hit the stone; small lifted chips catch their glow. Keep light falloff local and controlled. Leave dark rock visible BETWEEN the separate branches.
A shallow broken pressure ring and a few dust wisps around the origin reinforce the outward shock, but lightning is the dominant effect. This is not a circular magical seal, engraved rune pattern, flat symmetric star icon, fire explosion, pool of light, giant diagonal bolt, thick smooth glowing ribbon, tentacle or lightning-shaped slab. It is convincingly branching electrical energy surging outward from the feet of a future character. Preserve enough clean low-density air above that point for the future character's body, without a person-shaped hole, guide or silhouette.

SEPARATE BACKDROP — THE SKY'S JUDGMENT:
Behind the floor and outward discharge, create a dramatic towering SCENIC BACKGROUND MASS in a broad upright broken-crown / pointed-arch silhouette. Its edges are sculpted from dark storm clouds, sharp illuminated cloud spires and a few angular atmospheric breaks, not a literal crown or uniform frame. The mass contains substantial painted depth: monumental charcoal-indigo and muted violet storm clouds, remote mountain silhouettes, a distant storm-lit horizon.
High above the empty standing area, the cloud ceiling splits in a brilliant narrow white-gold opening. Two or three distant descending shafts of celestial judgment light extend from the opening THROUGH the back clouds. They remain behind the future character and are much softer/thinner than the foreground ground discharge. This is the solemn threatening background of DIVINE PUNISHMENT, visually separate from the active ground lightning. No god, face, angel, creature, crown object, religious emblem, written runes or giant weapon.
Keep the center air readable and mostly dark violet/blue to frame the later character. The distant heavenly light illuminates upper cloud edges; the ground-origin electrical burst independently lights the lower stone and shards. These two light sources have clear positions and different scales.

SPLASH FORM / DEPTH:
Use a near-square composition with upright rear mass and a broad foreshortened foreground ground plane, forming a strong triangular overall silhouette with pointed cloud peaks above and energetic lightning branches below. The backdrop actually contains storm scenery, not an empty outline. The small terrain is an irregular shattered stone terrace with visible plane changes, no giant round pedestal. Foreground branches project OUTSIDE the shaped backdrop into transparent space, extending toward the viewer beyond the stone edge; a few rear arcs disappear behind rocks. Maintain a distinct back-scenery layer, middle character staging area and forward VFX layer.
Render in clean refined anime game key-art style: fine controlled contour, clear shaded color planes, selective painted cloud softness, crisp stone facets, brilliant but carefully drawn electrical cores. High-end 2D illustration with dimensional composition; no photographic textures, 3D render or flat vector poster. Strong value hierarchy: subdued deep storm backdrop, clear pale stone midground, intensely luminous branching foreground electricity. Not uniformly bright or filled with equal particles.

OUTPUT:
No person, bow or arrow. ONE finished lightning splash background designed for a character to be added later. Outside the deliberately shaped scene is genuine transparent alpha, not a full rectangular landscape or solid background. Leave at least 8 percent transparent outer margin around cloud tips, rocks and all electrical branches. All key effects fully contained. No title, labels, UI, text, watermark, grid or borders.
framingEdit: Framing edit ONLY. Preserve this exact character-free divine-punishment storm backdrop and lightning spreading RADIALLY OUTWARD from the central empty standing spot across the floor. Pull the camera back enough that the entire composition occupies at most 80 percent of the square canvas width AND height. Leave a clearly EMPTY TRANSPARENT border at least 8 percent on ALL sides. Finish the currently clipped bottom foreground lightning branch: reconstruct its full tapering forked tips with empty space beyond them, and ensure upper cloud spike and side electrical branches are fully contained. Do not simply shrink an already-cut bolt; complete its electrical tips. Preserve all existing scene proportions, central origin, direction of electricity toward the viewer and sides, layer separation, shaped pointed cloud silhouette, heavenly descending light, dark violet storm, mountainous distance, foreground stone, white-gold/violet electric color and same clean anime-painterly rendering. No other design changes. No person, text, new props, plain filled background or added picture frame. Genuine transparent alpha outside the shaped scene. One complete unclipped splash background.
